tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rje btsun sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba rgya gar mkhas pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa phyin ci ma log pa'i yi ga
༄༅/ /rje btsun sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba rgya gar mkhas pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa phyin ci ma log pa'i yi ga

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba rgya gar mkhas pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa phyin ci ma log pa'i yi ge yang dag pa'o/ /

༄༅/ /na ma tu re gu ru tsa ra ṇa/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /bla ma dang yi dam gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la gus pas dngos kun rab btud nas/ /sgrib gnyis dri ma rab sbyangs phyir/ /dbang bskur cho ga legs bshad bya/ / 'bab bsregs rab brten dka' thub kyi ngal zhing*/ /thor tshug tshangs skud 'chang zhing ral ba bsgrigs/ /oṃ yig glu len las drug gis ngal ba/ /de dag yang dag ma yin rnam par spangs/ /bla med don dam gtor blug nges pa 'dis/ /bde chen bdud rtsi'i rang nyams 'pho ba yis/ /gdung sel gang yin bla ma'i man ngag ste/ /'gro la phan pa'i nyer 'tsho mchog tu gyur/ /rgyud las gsung dang slob dpon ngag /so so'i rang lugs rgya che ba/ /thams cad brjod par mi nus mod/ /bla ma'i zhal lung 'dir bshad bya/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid thams cad ldan/ /slob ma'ang yon tan kun ldan pa/ /de yis de dag cho ga 'di/ /bsdus na don gyi mchog ldan 'gyur/ /ltas brtags slob ma rjes bzung dang*/ /bsnyen pa bgegs tshogs gzhom pa dang*/ /gnas dus sa gzhi brtag slang bzung*/ /sbyang dang srung ba sta gon bzhi/ /thig tshon dkyil 'khor 'bri dang sgrub/ /mchod dang 'jug dang dbang blang ba/ /gshegs gsol bsdu dang sbyin sreg ste/ /cho ga nyer bzhi bla ma bzhed/ /slob ma lan gsum gsol btab na/ khrus dang gtsang sbra ldan byas la/ /sngags 'di nyer gcig bsngags byas te/ /'jig rten dbang la mchod byas nas/ /shar ram lho ru mngon phyogs pa'i/ /ma yengs ku sha'i stan la nyal/ /rmi lam mtshan ma legs par brtags/ sngags ni/ oṃ mu tsi li swāhā/ oṃ mo ha ni swāhā/ oṃ dan+ta li swāhā/ ltas bzang mthong na khas len bya/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin bsreg gis/ /slob mas sdig pa sbyang ba dang*/ /sa la sud liṅga bya/ /gnod byed sha za'i gzugs kyi bstim/ / ṭak+ki'i

sngags rgya'i bcug nas kyang*/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa bcing bar bsam/ lus nad gtogs pa'ang sha za'i gzugs/ /dgugs gzhugs lan ni gsum gsum bya/ /de la phur bus btab nas kyang*/ /dong ni gru gsum 'og tu bya/ /phyogs bcur de bzhin bya ba yin/ /gtso mor bskyed la srung ba bya/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags phyin la/ /re zhig 'bum phrag bzlas la gzhug /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i bsnyen pa dang*/ /slob ma'i don du lha mnyes pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor bsnyen pa'ang 'bad de bya/ /'khor lo bdag mo'i bzlas pa 'bum/ /dkyil 'khor can gyi khrir gsung bzhin/ /mtshan ma rtsub na khro bcu'am/ /phur gdab la sogs bsrung 'khor bya/ /gnas ni ri bo la sogs te/ /dus ni mgo dang nag pa dang*/ /sa ga smin drug zla ba la/ /tshes kyang gnyis gsum tshes brgyad dang*/ /bcu bzhi bco lnga la sogs bsngags/ /nyi zla lhag pa phur bu gza'/ /snar ma mgo lag rgyal dang dbo/ /me bzhi lha mtshams snron snrubs/ /gro bzhin chu stod khrum stod do/ /rnam sel shin skrag zug ngu 'bras/ /de sogs skar ma bzhin du sbyor/ /biṣ+ti dor ba'i byed pa blang*/ / gtor ma byin nas sa yang brtags/ /gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bzhin/ /phul nas pus btsugs thal sbyar te/ /tshig 'di lan gsum brjod par bya/ / gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gi bslang bar bgyi/ / dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ / zhes pa'o/ /'chang 'gyur cho ga sa lha las/ /blang nas dkyil 'khor sa gzhi'i dbus/ /rang 'dug dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bsgom/ /rig ma bzhi yi slob ma bzhis/ /mchod cing stod dbyangs snyan pa dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /zhes sogs gsang 'dus las gsungs pas/ /lan gsum phyogs bzhir nas gsol gdab/ /'khor los nam mkhar btegs nas ni/ khro bo'i lta bas bkra ba dang*/ /rkang ba rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/

/pad skor rdor dril 'dzin pa yis/ /rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bcings nas ni/ /snying mgrin dpral ba spyi bor gtugs/ / oṃ badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ/ hūṃ zhes lan gsum bskor ba bya/ /stang stabs bzhi po 'gying zhing bca'/ /dbus nas 'dus pa lan gsum bya/ / lus dang ngag sems zhes sogs brjod/ /yungs dkar gtor bas bgegs bskrad de/ /slar yang mi 'jug mtshams gcod bya/ /lho 'phye brtags na legs 'gyur mod/ /gcig tu dgos pa ma yin pas/ / dbang ldan mtshams nas bskor nas ni/ /bgegs dang ro bsal la sogs bya/ / oṃ bhū khaṃ/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ /hūṃ laṃ hūṃ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ / hūṃ bzhi pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ bdag nyid sgrol mar gsal ba'i snying ga nas phur bu'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros 'dod rgyal sngags kyis bgegs rnams bskrad/ phur bu bskul ba dang*/ phur ba'i btab pa'i sngags sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin phur bus btab ste/ dkyil 'khor gyis gzhi'i dbus kyi sar phur bu gcig gdab par mdzad de/ de nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba gnyis pa zhig spros te phur bu bsrung ba'i don du bzhugs pa la nyer spyod lnga phul/ bgegs bsrung bar gsol ba btab/ bdag nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil bar gyur pa rkang pa hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur/ hūṃ zhes bzla zhing g.yas skor du lan gsum du bskor bas/ gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar bgegs rnams sbyang bar bsam zhing*/ hūṃ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor du gyur par bsgoms la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod de/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha la mchod bstod srung ba bya'o/ /de dag ni sa sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /nang snga bar bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom la/ bzlas pa bya zhing*/ dkyil 'khor yang bdag nyid la nye bar bsdu'o/

/de nas mdun gyi sa gzhir me tog gi tshom bu dang mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ bsangs sbyangs/ mchod pa dang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa g.yas kyi sor mo gsum pa la reg ste/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam ste/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ pri thi bī de bī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ de yang gser gyi mdog can lte ba yan chad sa'i dkyil 'khor las phyung ba/ phyag g.yon gser gyi bum pa 'dzin cing*/ g.yas dpang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya can/ mdzes sdug rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa la/ me tog dkar po btab pa'i mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga dang gtor ma phul la/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gsol/ /shākya seṅge'i skyob pa yi/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de ni bdag gis bdud kyi stobs/ /bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ gnang ba byin nas thim par bsam/ yang na gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar/ sa chog dus su nam mkhar btegs/ 'dir ni phab nas mchod bstod byas la/ sa gzhi la thim par bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha so so'i gnas su/ rang sngags kyi me tog gi tshom bu re bkod la/ bsangs sbyangs/ gzhan yas khang gdan dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ zhes brjod cing so so'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha ā sa na hūṃ/ zhes dkyil 'khor gyis lha re re'i sngags kyi mthar btags ste gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ rang gi nam mkhar btegs pa'i lha rnams 'bar ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs la dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya/ yan lag dang skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams byas la/

bdug spos thogs te/ dam tshig sgrol ma bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor bri/ /de phyir byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs/ /gang yang bstan la mngon dga' rnams/ /sems can 'di la byin brlabs shing*/ /dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ / zhes snyan gsan dbabs par bya'o/ /rdo rje shugs kyi sngags rgyas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs/ mchod cing bstod la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa/ sogs kyis/ bsrung ba'i bskor bar bya'o/ /slob ma sta gon du gnas pa ni/ slob ma rnams myang 'das kyi sems brtan po zhig bskyed du gzhug /slob dpon dam tshig rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma gri thod 'dzin pa'i 'khyud par bskyed de/ slob ma rnams yab kyi zhal du zhugs te pad+mar phyung ba/ sgrol ma phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur ba bha ga'i mtha' nas spros te/ phyi rol du 'khod pa las/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ /'don par mdzad pa khyod 'ba' zhig /bdag gi ston pa dgyes chen khyod/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyab gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ / thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ / zha ེ sa gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ bu tshur shog cig theg chen po/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gang gis shākya seṅge sogs/

/mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ / mi bzad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtog nas ni/ / 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig / ces brjod de/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /zhes brjod du gzhug go /de ltar thun mong gi sdom pa can gyis slob dpon gyi sdom pa bzung ba'i phyir/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*/ /dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon bgyid/ / ces gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /blo chen khyod kyis gzung bya ste/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes su bshad/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i/ /sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs/ / rin chen rigs mchog chen po la/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos khyod kyis gzung bar bgyi/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsung*/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar gyis/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus byos/ /de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni/ / phas pham par ni rab tu bshad/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/

/rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya/ /gal te nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang mi blang ngo*/ /'dod la log par mi spyad cing*/ /rdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /chang ni rnam par spang bar bya/ /sems can don phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spang*/ /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing*/ /rnal 'byor ma kun bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*/ /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*/ /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus par ni rjes su brkyang*/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab phyogs min/ /'khor ba dag kyang yong mi spong*/ /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing*/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*/ /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad/ /ces lan gcig bsgrags/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ /zhes lan gsum bzung*/ gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gyi dri'i thig le byas la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ /ba lci'i dkyil 'khor du hūṃ las byung ba'i so shing*/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ zhes 'dor du gzhug / oṃ hrīḥbi shudha dharma sarba pa paṃ nish+tsa a s+ya sho dha ya/ sarba bi kalpa na a pā na ya hūṃ/ zhes kha bkrur gzhug /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis srung skud sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa bhan+dha dhaṃ baṃ/ zhes rtsa sngo ljang gi stan sbyin par bya'o/ /slar yang bsangs gtor byas la/ gnas bdun du rtsa sngags yi ge bcu pas bsrung ba bya/ /nangs par gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro/

/zhes brjod/ rin chen lnga'i phye ma'am 'bras sogs kha dog bsgyur ba dang*/ min na rdo'i phye mas rung*/ /kun la sha chen khrag chen bsre/ /skye gnas ma nyams bu mo yis/ /thig skud gsar pa legs bkal pa/ /dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur tshad byas la/ /rnam lnga kha dog so sor bya/ /thig skud dang rdul tshon sngon po hūṃ las mi bskyod pa/ dkar po oṃ las rnam snang*/ ser po trāṃ las rin 'byung*/ dmar po hrīḥlas 'od dpag med/ ljang khu ā las don yod grub pa rnams skad cig gis 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed la/ gnas gsum dang skye mched byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur te thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ gtor ma sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis rlabs la/ a kā ro sa/ phul/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las thig tshon du gyur/ sngon po la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūṃ hūṃ/ dkar po la/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzi ka oṃ hūṃ/ ser po la/ oṃ āḥrat+na dhṛka drāṃ hūṃ/ dmar po la/ oṃ āḥ.a ro l̥ka hrīḥhūṃ/ ljang khu la/ oṃ āḥpra dz+nyā dhṛka a hūṃ/ /

zhes re re mang du bzlas/ de nas slob dpon rdo rje sems dpar mos la skad cig tsam gyis don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur/ rig ma bcu gnyis lo lon pa sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang bcas te/ thig ni gdab par bya ba nyid/ /rdo rje dang bcas lag gis bzung*/ /re re bzhin du der gtad la/ /oṃ a n+yo3 n+ya a nu ga tāḥsarba dharma pa ra spar a nu pra biṣ+ta sarba dharma ad+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+taḥsarba dharma hūṃ/ rig ma'i thig skud sgril bar bya/ /ji skad rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin/ /phyogs ma nor bar thig brgyad gdab/ / oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /'gro don mdzad du 'di lag pas/ deng 'dir byin gyis rlobs shig ces/ thig skud sgras ni bskul ma 'debs/ hūṃ/ thig skud nam mkha' gang ba yin/ /de bzhin gshegs kun mnyes par bsam/ / rang nub rig ma shar gnas la/ /lho byang thig ni gdab par bya/ /rang lho rig ma byang gnas pas/ / shar nub thig kun sngags 'di dag / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pu traṃ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ de ltar ye shes thig btab nas/ khrag chen chang dang bdud rtsi lngas/ /brlan pa'i rdo rgyus dag gis ni/ /zhu bas thig ni gdab par bya/ /dkyil 'khor cha ni bcu drug ste/ /gzhal yas khang pa nyid la'o/ /rta babs sgo tshad gcig tu bya/ /snam bu bcu gcig yang na bzhi/ /rtsig pa'i thig la reg par gdab/ /yang na har sgor byas pa yin/ /ka rgyan gyi ni g.yas g.yon du/ /mchod rten gzugs kyis shin tu mdzes/ /bzhi pa phyed gdan nang ma gdab/ /gsum pa'ang de bzhin dbus su ni/ /re mig dgu pa zlum por bskor/ /pad+ma rdo rje me'i phyi rol/ /dur khrod gnas ni ci bder bzhag /de nyid dkyil 'khor mchog tu mdzes/ /rdo rje shugs kyis sogs nas ni/ /bdud rtsir 'khyil bar bsnyems pa yis/ /sgo dbye'i sngags dang phyag rgya bya/ /hi hi zhes pas rtsa thig dbyi'o/ /dbus kyi phur bu'i khung bur ni/

/nag dmar dkar ser ljang khu steng*/ /tshon lnga rig mas bris par bya/ /de yis steng du slob dpon gyi/ /dkar dmar ljang khu'i tshon gsum bri/ / 'di ni chos nyid dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya/ /oṃ sa ma hoḥ.a haṃ/ de nas ci bder tshon bgye'o/ /'dir tshon gyi rim pa rnams ni/ dbus kyi gdung dang ka ba nag /re mig rnams dang gru chad sngo/ /ut+pal dmar po sil mar bcas/ /snam bu lnga rnams rim pa bzhin/ /nag dmar sna tshogs ser dang dkar/ /phyogs mdog dang po mi shes brgyan/ /gzhan rnams me tog phra mo bkram/ /dra phyed phyir bstan mun pa nag /mchod rten dkar zhing khyams ljang khu/ /ka rgyan glang po seṅge dang*/ /ri dwags la sogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /gzhan dag ji skad bshad bzhin te/ /pa ṭa sprin dang me tog sogs/ /rgyud nas bshad pa'i tshon rnams phyir/ /gzugs tshogs ma yis blo gros ni/ /mkhas pa'i rang du spongs shig gsung*/ /dbus su ut+pal sngon po bri/ /phyogs bzhir pad dkar gser bum dang*/ / lcags kyu ral gri phyogs mdog bri/ /mtsham bzhir ut+pal sku mdog mtshungs/ /gra bzhir tho ba ral gri dang*/ / dbyug pa phur bu rnam par dgod/ /las kyi snam bu dbus ma la/ /lha yi mdog mtshungs gdan du byas la/ phyag mtshan bri na g.yas kyi lam/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa dang*/ /lcags sgrog dril bu mdzes par bri/ /yang na khams dang rtsa shing las/ /legs bcos phyag mtshan 'god pa'o/ / lugs ma'am bris sku sa sogs kyi/ /sku gzugs dgod par byas kyang rung*/ /yang na sa bon sngags bcas dgod/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor bri ba'i cho ga'o/ /der mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya cher bshams/ bsangs chu sgrub pa la bsrung ba bya'o/ /de nas lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa'am/ med na maṇ+ḍal man dzi dang bcas pa'i steng du bum pa lnga tshom du bkod/

las bum log shig tu byas/ dbus su mngon rtogs ltar gtso mo lha tshogs gzhan thams cad dang bcas pa bskyed/ phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i sgrol ma bskyed la/ thams cad kyang dbu rgyan rang chas su bsgom/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa bsre/ oṃ kalpa prak+ṣa ya swāhā/ zhes kha rgyan byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ tap+te tap+te maha tap+te swāhā/ dung chos kyis nang du lha'i chu bo gaṅgā bab par bsam/ de nas gzungs thag blang nas gtso mo'i sngags brgya rtsa bzlas la/ las bum gyi bdud rtsi 'khyil ba snga ma'i cho gas bskyed nas/ rang sngags brgya'i bar du bzlas la/ mthar gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs ci rigs pa bzlas la/ slar yang mchod bstod gtor ma phul la/ mchod yon phul bas zhu bar bsam ste yi ge 'bru gsum brjod/ las bum gyi chu shing gi yal gas blangs/ bum pa'i mtha' skor zhing gnas khang la gtor bsung ba mdzod cig ces bya/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i bum pa nyid las bum yin pas/ las bum zur du bca' mi dgos/ de nas slob ma rnams la rmi lam gyi ltas dris la/ ngan na sbyin bsregs kyis ni bzlog pa bya/ ltas bzang bar mthong na/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya ste/ nang snga bar 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma byin la/ ye shes tshogs bsog mngon rtogs lhar bsgom la/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ mngon rtog rdzogs par bskyed la/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyis dbus su 'dug par bsam la/ bzlas pa la thug gi bar mngon rtogs ltar bya ba la/ dbang bskur rgyas btab song ba'i mtshams su/ sta gon gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ bgegs bskrad la gnyis su med par thim/ dkyil 'khor gyis mtha' mchod gtor gyi legs par bskor la/ bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga/ nang mchod/ rjes chags kyi mchod pa/

sgeg sogs brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ sogs kyi rgyas par mchod nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma mngon rtogs ltar phul/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma 'grub na/ shar du lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ nub tu klu/ lhor phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma'i cho ga ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par 'bul zhing*/ bsdu na/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis 'bul/ /shar sgo nas dgyes pa rdo rje nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje glu blangs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi'i sgo phye bas nang du zhugs te/ shar sgo'i thad kyi lha rnams 'dug par mos/ oṃ rdo rje sems khyod rol par mdzod/ /thams cad mthu yis thams cad rtsol bar mdzod/ /ji snyed mchod pa de snyed bdag 'bul na/ /'khor bar gnas pa skad cig gis grol mdzod sa ma ya ho ho/ lang tsho bcu gnyis lo lon sems brtan ma/ /de ru rjes su chags pas mnyes byas la/ /byang chub sems spro 'od kyi bde gshegs mchod/ khu rdul lce la bzhag byas gtor bar bya/ /de ltar yang 'dus pa las/ mig bzang brtan pa'i blo brtan ma/ khu ba blangs nas bza' bar bya/ /zhes so/ /bod dag 'dir ni bsam pa kho na yin gyi/ /dngos su na ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes smra'o/ /bla ma'i zhal nas/ de ltar na ni gsang dbang la yang der 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsung zhing sems dge ba la nyes pa med par bshad pa'i don ma go ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du gnas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du gnas pas/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir maṇ+ḍal byas la/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ / zhes sogs lan gsum gsol ba btab/ oṃ sarba ta ga ta bo dhi a laṅka ra wasra pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes smad g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes stod g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa hūṃ/ zhes gtsug tor bcing*/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyi gdong g.yogs bcing*/

a khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ zhes me tog gi chun po gtad/ gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum bkod la bdud rtsi lnga'i thig le bya/ skye ba'i gnas lngas taṃ yig re re bsgom la/ yi ge bcu pa'i bsang gtor byas pas sgrol ma rigs lngar gyur/ gtor ma sgron me lnga dang bcas pa slob ma la bskor nas lha mo lnga po rnams kyi sku las 'od zer byung*/ khams lnga la brtan pa'i nad dang gdon dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad khyi dang spre'u'i tshul gyi phyir byung ste sgron me lnga la thim/ oṃ ru ru spu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ne swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ma ma ki ri ki ri hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ ka ḍe bi ka ḍe ka ḍa ka ḍaṃ ka dre swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes bzlas/ bden pa bdar/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas yungs dkar gtor zhing*/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas la/ bgegs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam/ /slob dpon gyis slob ma'i gnas bdun du bsrung ba bya'o/ / kye khyod su yin/ bdag ni bskal ba bzang po'o/ /skal bzang des khyod ci zhig bya/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig bdag 'tshal lo/ /snying gar zla ba rdo rje'i sbyor ba'i/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi mahā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta ut+pa dā ya mi/ zhes rnal 'byor dang bde ba chen po sems bskyed a ti sha'i 'brel ba las ni/ slob ma'i snying gar ā li bcu drug las zla ba na/ oṃ tsit+ta pra ti bi dhaṃ ka ro mi/ slar yang zla ba gnyis pa/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ zla ba'i steng du/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ rdo rje las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje gyur pa rdo rje la thim badz+ra ut+ma ko3haṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag nyid lha'i sku bde ba chen po'o/ /oṃ sarba ya tha sarba ta thā ga tā tha a haṃ/ zhes brjod du gzhug ste mngon byang lngas sems bskyed par mdzad do/ /de nas/

ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ de nas nang du bcug la phyogs bzhi nas/ oṃ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mor yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ na ma te hūṃ/ na mā mi hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ swāhā zhes phyogs re re nas phyag gsum gsum bya/ phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar dam bzhag lnga bya/ ye shes dbab pa la rnam pa gsum las/ dang po yang phreng ba'i ye shes dbab pa bzhin mdzad do/ /gnyis pa bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis ye shes dbabs pa ni/ spyi bor bla ma sku ji lta bar mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can la/ /lo bcu gnyis mas yang dag par 'khyud pa/ de nyid snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems kyis lus gang*/ bla ma snying gar thon/ lus bde ba chen pos khyab/ sngags kyi sgra 'ur 'ur 'dug pas bde ba bskul bar bsam la/ rol mo je drag je zhan bya/ gsum pa slob ma rnams sgrol ma rigs kyi bu mo bcu gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can bde ba rgyas par mos la/ snying gar don grub yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa la sems 'jog tu bcug cing*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs par slob dpon gyi mos la/ oṃ ma li mi li hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes drag tu bzla zhing rol mo bya/ rol mo sgra ni lag len bzhin myur dal spel ma bya/ des kyang ma babs na bar chad yin pas/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags drag tu bzla zhing*/ slar yang dbab par bya'o/ /phebs pa ni brtan par bya ste/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya/ pra ti pa ti ta/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍiḍh+ro me bha ba= zhes sogs kyis me tog dor/ de nas phyi rol du dri bzang dang rang byung gi rdul gyis dkyil 'khor gru bzhi byas la/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i me tog bkod de/ de nas lha so sor mos la/ mdun skyed kyi thugs ka nas ye shes pa gnyis spyan drangs/ mchod bstod gtso bo'i snying po mang du bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs/

bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang*/ mi g.yo ba'i sngags kyi bsrung ba byas la/ dar dmar po dgab bar bya'o/ /skabs 'dir rdul tshon la phul bar mos nas/ dngos su me tog gi maṇ+ḍal dor ro/ /rigs kyi lha 'di yin zhes brda' sprad/ de nas gnas gdong dar dkrol ba dang*/ blta bar bskul ba 'phreng ba bzhin bya/ slob dpon gyi me tog thog ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams re re bzhin sgom tshul rgyas par bshad/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la mahā maṇ+ḍa la pra be sho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga maṇ+ḍa la mahā maṇ+ḍal dri she two3haṃ/ oṃ gu h+ya maṇ+ḍa la mahā maṇ+ḍal a bhi ṣa ka two3haṃ/ zhes ched du brjod pa bya bar gzhug /de nas slob dpon la maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje= sogs kyi gsol ba btab/ nang dbang yan lag zhi spyi dang mthun par byas la/ rigs kyi lhas me tog gis phreng ba spyi bor bcing par bsam/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa staṃ/ i maṃ satwa ma bā la/ zhes me tog spyi bor bzhag /lha thams cad kyi sngags kyis bsngags pa'i dri'i chu dung chos su blang nas lha thams cad kyi dbang bskur bar bsam la/ ji ltar bltam pa= sogs brjod cing dbang bskur/ lha rnams rin po che'i cod pan spyi bor bcing par bsam la/ me tog phreng ba mgo la bcing*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas slob ma'i snying gar 'phos par bsam la/ rus 'phreng mgrin par bzhag la/ bzlas lung lan gsum dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung bya/ de phyin chad lha dang bla ma nam du yang spang bar ma byed cig /zhes brjod/ de dag ni rig pa gtad pa'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas bum chu rnams thod par bsdus la sa bon bzhi las lha mo bzhi'i ngo bor mos/ slob ma skad cig gis mi bskyod pa he ru kar mos/ rang 'dra'i dbu rgyan rang chas su bcas su bsam/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang ye shes pa gzhug /dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ me tog gtor zhing rol mo'i bar du mchod pa bya'o/

/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñcan+tu maṃ sarba ta tha ga tāḥ zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug /phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar shis pa brjod/ sangs rgyas rnams ni= zhes kyis mthar/ oṃ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes dbang skur/ de nas dbu rgyan zhu ba las rdo rjer sgom/ slob ma 'od dpag med du bskyed la/ sa bon lnga las de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bo bskyed la/ slob ma rin 'byung sgom/ oṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ hūṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes dbu rgyan mgo la bkon pas/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan par bsam/ rdo rje khaṃ las don yod grub pa rang snang gi yum can du bskyed la/ oṃ hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje lag tu gtad/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid kyang byin la/ dril bu taṃ las gtso mor bskyed de zhu nas/ slob ma don yod grub par bskyed/ oṃ hūṃ tāṃ hūṃ badz+ra a dhi pa taṃ staṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ dril bu lag pa g.yon du gtad la/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid dang*/ rig ma yang dag par gtad pas phyag rgyas de nyid kyang sbyin par bya'o/ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ las rdo rje dang dril bu sgo ma bzhi'i ngo bor mos/ slob ma rnam snang du bskyed la/

oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra satwa stoṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta he shri/ che ge mo rdo rje zhes ming gdags par bya'o/ /bud med la ni mā ma kī sogs yum la yab kyis 'khyud par bskyed pa yin no/ /dbang de dag re re'i mthar chu dbang re bskur zhing*/ 'di'i mgo mjug tu 'byung ba'i chu dbang thams cad la rol mo'i sgra mdzad cing*/ khye'u dang bu mo mchod rdzas thog pa rnams kyis mchod par bya/ de nas mig thur/ me long*/ mda' gzhi/ dril bu rnams phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ slob mas las bzhi'i lha mo so sor bskyed la/ dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas ye shes pa re re bzhin du bstim la/ las bzhi'i so so'i bum pa'i dbang bskur/ so so'i bzlas lung sbyin/ rdo rje brtul zhugs ma rgyud spyi dang mthun par byin la/ hūṃ las 'byung ba'i gri gug dang*/ a las byung ba'i thod khrag lag pa g.yon du sbyin la/ oṃ karki ka ri/ sarba mā ra ṇaṃ/ māṃ pa karta yarta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka pā la sarba sha truṃ ṇaṃ/ rak+taṃ dha ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ snying po bzlas pa'i cang te'u g.yas dang*/ rtsa sngags bzlas pas ut+pal g.yon du byin la/ mchan khung du kha ṭaṃ ga bkod la/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgoms shig bya/ de nas lung bstan dang dbugs dbyung*/ gzengs bstod dang*/ dam tshig bstan pa rnams kyang phreng ba las 'byung ba bzhin du bya/ dam tshig la gnas pa'i slob ma thun mong ba rnams re zhig de tsam gyi don yod grub par bya'o/ /rigs lnga'i dam tshig bzung bar mi nus na/ sems bskyed dam bzhag /ye shes 'bar ba rnams dor/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams rdzogs par bya/ nang dbang mi bskur bar rig gtad tsam bya/ de la ni sta gon gyi skabs su yang rig lnga'i sdom bzung mi bya'o/ /gal te tshe 'di nyid la mchog don du gnyer ba la ni dbang gong ma bzhi yang sbyin par bya dgos la/ de la dbang stegs pad+ma dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i steng du slob ma bzhag

/gsol btab dang dam tshig gsum sbyin pa sngon du 'gro ba'i/ slob ma'i snying gar gzhal yas khang bskyed la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas lha rnams rdzogs par spros de rang rang gi sngags kyis slob ma'i snying ga'i gzhal yas khang du bkod/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la bstim/ de ni sku'i dbang ngo*/ /gsung rdo rje/ yan lag bskyed pa'i dung chos la tsan+dan dmar po'i phreng ba lag tu gtad la/ ā li kā li de nyid lnga spel du byas pa lan gsum brjod cing snying po lan brgya'i bzlas lung sbyin no/ /phreng ba spyi bor bzhag /snying ga'i lha tshogs rnams sa bon gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ yi ge'i gzugs kyis ye shes pa bstim/ gsung gi dbang ngo*/ /rdo rje snying gar bkod la/ snying po'i mthar rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi sngags bcug pas phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ phyag mtshan gyi ye shes pa stim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mtshon cha 'khor lo bla na med/ /rnal 'byor ma yi bu khyod long*/ /'khor lo'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ / oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta tsakra brta na a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ de bzhin du badz+ra dang rdo rje sogs 'don pa spos la/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur te thugs kyi dbang ngo*/ /rdo rje gur las 'byung ba ltar/ rigs lnga'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs/ phyag rgya lnga slob ma'i lus la bkod la/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni shes rab ste/ / thabs kyi rang bzhin cang te nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ming pos gzung*/ / de ni spyod pa'i dbang ngo*/ /slar yang las bzhi'i bum pa rang sngags kyis dbang bskur/ 'phrin las kyi dbang ngo*/ /dngos grub brgyad kyi gzugs brnyan byas la lag tu gtad nas/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*/

/mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar bsgrub par gyis/ / dngos grub kyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas dam tshig dang ldan pa'i bud med lang tsho ma chas su gzhug pa/ dam tshig sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan la/ slob ma rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis dngos su 'khyud du bcug nas/ de'i bde ba ngo sprad la nu ma ru gzhug go /de ni bum pa'i dbang gi dngos gzhi'am/ bdun po de dag re re'i mthar skye gnas ma nyams pa'i bu mos thogs pa'i bum pa las/ yal 'dab kyi chu blangs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje/ sogs kyi 'jug tu/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ de dag gi slob ma la mchod bstod rgya chen po byas la/ de nas slob ma'i snying gar gzungs thag rdo rje bzung la/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha= / sogs dang rten 'brel snying po lan mang du bzlas shing*/ me tog tor la rol chen bya/ ro dro swa sti sogs shis brjod bya/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang 'di nyid la de nyid la skos su mi byed na/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa'i sngon/ chu nas ming gis bar du ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyin pa'am/ dngos su bsdus pa sbyin par bya'o/ /dbang gi mthar rtsa ba'i ltung ba la sogs pa dam tshig gi rnam bzhag ci rigs pa bshad/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ / zhes brjod du gzhug / gsang ba 'di su la'ang smra bar mi bya'o/ /gal te smras na de yi tshe/ /shin tu rno pa'i shu la ni/ rnal 'byor ma yi phyag na gnas/ /gang gis dam tshig 'jig byed pa/ /de la 'di yis mchog tu 'bigs/ /oṃ mahā sa ma ya ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces rtse gsum snying gar bzhag /de nas rjes kyi bya ba mtha' dag bya'o/ /gal te gsang dbang bskur 'dod na/ /lha ma gshegs par bya ba shes/ / yang na maṇ+ḍal byas nas ni/ /chos 'byung zur drug tshom bu bcas/ /bdag mdun dbyer med rnam par bsgoms/

/mchod gtor dbang 'jug blang bar bya/ /slob ma dkyil 'khor khang pa yis/ / phyi rol yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ /bu mo lo bcu drug nas nyi shu'i bar mtshan nyid tshang ba slob dpon la phul te/ khyed la 'di ni 'bul lags kyi/ /'dod don bde ba rab tu rtsol/ /bdag ni 'dod pa'i bde don gnyer/ /mgon po khyod kyi brtse bas zungs/ / byang chub rdo rje= sogs kyis lan gsum gsol btab/ mig dar/ me tog sems bskyed sngar ltar bya/ mgrin par chos 'byung gi dbus su sngags phreng g.yon du bskor ba la sems gtad/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ rig pa'i dbang lnga slob ma dang phyag rgya gnyis ka la mdor bsdus su bskur la/ phyag rgya rnam rtog dang bcas pa yin na gdong bcing*/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te snyoms par zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems gsang bar lhan cig skyes pas ye shes brtan par byas pa'i thig le cung zad yum gyi mkhar gyur cing rdo rje la gnas pa byang chub kyi sems slob ma'i khar bab ste/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /de bzhin du ni byang chub sems/ /bzang pos bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ / snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la/ shes rab ma'i pad+ma la gnas pa'i thig le yang*/ slob ma'i khar bab la/ 'di ni dpa' bo lha mo rnams/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ khams lnga las byung bcud kyi len/ /bde ba chen po myang bar bgyi/ / zhes so/ /des kyang*/ e ma bde ba chen po la'o/ / zhes brjod/ gdong g.yogs sngar bzhin bsal nas/ pad+ma la bltas pa'i dga' ba ngo sprad/ nang mchod byin la/ khrag chen po ni ga bur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar dang yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i chu dang bcas/ /lnga pa sems las byung bar bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /bzang po khyod kyis bskyang bar bya/ / de nas shes rab ye shes dbang gi dbang bskur bar 'dod na/ /maṇ+ḍal gru gsum pad+mar bcas/

/gzhan ni ji ltar sngar bshad bzhin/ /snying ga'am lte bar zur drug pa/ /'khyil ba dang bcas bskor bas phebs/ / bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba/ /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ / zhes dang*/ dbang po gnyis kyis sbyor ba gang*/ / rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid de/ /ye shes mtshon cha rnams 'chang ba/ /mngon spyod sna tshogs spyod pa po/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i sngags can ma/ / dbang po'i dra ba 'phro zhing 'od zer 'khrugs/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i mtshan ma dang gcug mdzad/ /blo gros chen pos bdag la dbang bskur mdzod/ / ces lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab par bya/ /gal te gsang dbang gi phyag rgya de nyid slob ma nyid kyi phul ba yin na/ 'dir slob ma la sbyin du rung ste/ ro mnyam slob ma'i spyod yul nyid/ /de nyid la yang bya bar bya/ / zhes so/ /gzhan du na slob dpon gyi phyag rgya la bgrod pas ni dmyal ba'i rgyu mi bzad pa yin pa'i phyir gsang dbang yan chad thob pa la ma nyams pa'i bu mo gzhan zhig gi lag pa sbyin te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i/ /lha mo 'di ni khyod ma shes/ /mtha' yas bde la sbyin pa mo/ /rnam pa kun du phyag rgya long*/ /gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gis dngos grub med/ / de gnyis don 'grub yab yum du bskyed la/ lce la bdud rtsi bzhag cing rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur/ skye mched lnga dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dga' bzhi'i rnam bzhag dang bde stong sgom tshul zhib tu bshad la/ rab rib ma'am 'thib mo'i mchod pa'am/ dben khang gzhan du slob dpon 'gro bar bya'o/

/de'i shes rab ma gos dang bral ba dri bzang gis bgos pa'i pad+ma mdzub mos gsal bar bstan te/ ci bde bu khyod 'di spro'am/ /nga las dam tshig len par ni/ /bshang gci rak+ta bza' ba dang*/ /bha ga'i mtha' nas 'jib byed dam/ slob mas kyang*/ khyod las mi gtsang bza' bar ni/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ / bdag gi mi mo kun gus bya/ / yang smras pa/ a re bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /bdag nyid dngos grub rtsol mdzad ma/ /dal bu dal bus rab sbyor bas/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyi/ /dbus su ze'u 'brus rnam brgyan pa'i/ /chu skyes 'dab ma gsum par gzigs/ /a ho bde ba can gyi zhing*/ /sangs rgyas sku mdog dmar pos mdzes/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo tshul/ /des ni bu khyod 'bras bur bcas/ / de nas sngon slob dpon gyis bstan pa'i cho ga'i rim pas mkha' gsang byin rlabs/ /de kho na nyid kyis nges pa brtan po bskyed la/ rjes su chags pa'i dga' ba tsam par bya ste/ de la tshig gi bskul ba dang*/ /rjes chag spel ba la rtsa btsal ba dang*/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i sbyor ba la brten nas bde ba'i ye shes ngos bzung ba dang*/ dga' bzhi'i dbye ba'i mchog tu nges par bya ba dang*/ bde ba sa bcu gsum dang sbyar bas so/ /de la dang po ni/ shes rab mas/ rol zhig rol zhig bdag la rol/ /'dod pa gyis shig dga' gsal ma/ khyod kyi gzhan du mi rtogs pas/ /rtogs pas the tshom ma byed cig / ces glu blangs te/ phan tshun rjes su chags pa drag tu bskyed de/ gnyis pa ni/ pad+ma can la sogs pa rig dang rjes su mthun pa'i sbyor thabs so sor bya zhing*/ shes rab kyis mgul nas dam du 'khyud pa'i bcings shing skra nas bzung bas gdong mi g.yo ba legs par blta/ bung ba lta bu i yig gi sgra'i glu dang*/ brla gnyis kyi bar tu nye bar blta bas mchu yis rtse bar bya/

'gying bag gi stabs kyi 'khyud nas lkog ma la brten te ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi gzhib/ rtsa bskul bslang ba rnams bskul ba'i phyir/ /nu ma gnyis dang lag sor gyi rtse mo rnams dang*/ /ma mchu dang*/ 'gram pa dang*/ rna ba'i rtse mo dang*/ mig gi mtha' dang*/ spyi bo dang*/ gsang ba rnams su tsum pa bya'o/ /bar pa rnams bskul ba'i phyir/ rna ba gnyis dang*/ mchan khung gnyis dang*/ nam tshong dang bha ga'i 'gram gnyis su sen mos btab/ dka' ba rnams bskul ba'i phyir du nu ma gnyis dang*/ mchan khung gnyis dang*/ lag mthil gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis su mnye zhing*/ so'i ri mo bya'o/ /pad+ma'i mtha' rnams bskul ba dang*/ lce gsum bskyod pa'i sbyor bas/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ na ra na si ka mchog tu rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /steng dang 'og tu rnam par bltas pas kyang rjes su chags pa bskul nas/ ji skad bshad pa'i rjes kyi dbang mchog la nye bar bgos te/ g.yon phyogs na gnas pa'i rtsa bya gdong gi gzugs can sad par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rdo rje pad+mar reg par bsnyen pa/ rdo rje pad+mar zhugs pa nyer bsgrub dang*/ bskyod pa las shes rab ma la ye shes rnam pa lnga'i rtags mchog gi nye bar brgyan pa na/ shes rab ma rjes su chags pa'i rtags des kyang*/ rang rgyud kyi bde ba chen po re re nas lhag par 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang snying 'dar ba dang dran pa nyams pa ni me long ye shes/ skra grol zhing 'dug tshul zhig pa ni sor rtogs ye shes/ gos 'dor zhing rnam rtog bral ba ni chos dbyings ye shes/ lus rdul gyi khyab pa ni mnyam nyid ye shes/ bzhin dmar po 'gyur ba dang*/ mig phra pa dang*/ zim bus blta ba ni bya grub ye shes te/ de dag gi sgrub pa'o/ /de nas byang chub kyi sems nor bur son pa na bde ba yun ring du bsgom zhing*/ gal te thig le 'dzag pa 'dra na btsan thabs kyi sbyor bas bkag pas/ rang dang rig ma gnyis car ba spu ldang ba dang mchi ma 'byung ba sogs nyid stobs brgyad 'byung ngo*/

/ de dag gi sgrub pa chen po'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ thabs shes rjes su chags pas 'khyud dang 'o byed pa dang nu ma mnyed la sogs pa 'khrul 'khor gyi rim pas/ dbang po gnyis sbyor ba'i bar du dga' ba dri bde ba cung tsam bskyed do/ /mtsho skyes kyi 'dab mar chud ba'i rdo rje bskyod pa las nor bu'i rtsa bar byang sems 'ong pa'i bar du mchog dga' ste/ de las lhag pa'i bde ba'o/ /pad+ma'i sbubs su son pa'i nor bu las thig les shes rab ma'i sna rtser spros pa 'di ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes te/ shes rab ye shes kyi dngos gzhi'o/ /de nas sngon nyams su myong ba 'di lta bu'o zhes nye bar sems pa'i bde ba ni dga' bral te chags bral lo/ /las dang po pas dbang gi skabs su bzung bar ma nus na/ byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis dkyil 'khor dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa'i sprin spros par bsam nas/ phaṭaḥ ces brjod cing thig le phyung la pad+ma la gnas pa lces blang par bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/ gzugs mdzes pa mthong ba'i bde ba la sems zin na sa dang po dang*/ de bzhin du glu dbyangs dang*/ 'khrig tshig dang*/ dga' ba'i sgra las byung ba'i bde ba sa gnyis pa dang*/ dri tshor ba las byung ba'i bde ba sa gsum pa dang*/ o tha gzhib pa las byung ba'i bde ba sa bzhi pa dang*/ phyi'i reg bya'i bde bas sa lnga pa dang*/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i ye shes sa drug pa dang*/ chu skyes dam zhing dgos pa la sogs pa khams kyi bde ba bdun pa dang*/ rdo rje nor bu'i zil ba sogs chu khams las thob pa sa brgyad pa dang*/ bha ga laṅga'i drod sogs me khams las dgu pa dang*/ lus 'dar ba dang thig le g.yo ba sogs rlung las thob pa'i bde ba ni bcu pa dang*/ de dag las skyes pa'i chags pa dang chags bral dang chags pa bar ma'i ye shes re re sa re re ste/ de ltar na lhan skyes ye shes bcu gsum pa rdo rje 'dzin pa lhag pa'i lha'o/
/de yang bdag dang rig ma lhar gsal ba dang*/ skra grol ba sdul ba sogs/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yan lag

/'khyud cing snyoms par 'jug pa kha sbyor gyi yan lag /thig le zhu ba bde chen gyis yan lag /de la sems zin pa pas stong bar mthong ba rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag /de ltar na ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje 'jug pa snying rje chen po'i yan lag /sems bde ba dang gsal rig rtag tu gnas pa rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag go /'bras bu la mi bsdu ba nyid kyi yan lag bdun ldan te/ 'on kyang gnas gsang ba 'ba' zhig dang*/ 'phral du skye 'gag byed pa/ ngal ba sogs sdug bsngal dang bcas pas don dam pa'i bde ba ma yin/ lam 'di kho na'i ye shes kyi sa bcu gsum myur du thob par 'gyur gyi/ thabs gzhan gyi ma yin no/ /yang na dbang 'di tshig gis sbyin par bya'o/ /gsal snang ma thob pa de srid du las kyi phyag rgya las gzhan pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ dbang gi ye shes nyams su myong ba med pa'i phyir/ mchog zab pa ma yin ces gsungs so/ /de nas slob dpon la yon dbul zhing*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya'o/ /tsa tu med la dbang mi bskur/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo med pa la/ /gsang ba shes rab dbang mi bskur/ /bzhi pa'i don gyi de nyid ni/ /mchog gi slob ma dag la sbyin/ khengs ldan nyan thos gsang mi thub/ /blun po rgyal po rtog ge ba/ /rgan po la sogs dbang bzhi bkal/ /nyi ma gzhan la mchod pa dang*/ /bcas nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab/ bla ma'i phyag rgya gtad de/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngos 'dzin du bcug /de nyid dper byas te rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ngo sprad/ kun khyab gdung med rgyun mi chad/ /rnam rtog 'thib cing rang rig pa/ / zab gsal gnyis su med pa ste/ /thig le bde ba kha sbyor ba'o/ /dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ lha'i sku phyogs bcur bgrod pa dang*/

mang don legs par rtsa gcod pa sogs man ngag ltar shes par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon ji ltar mnyes pa de de nyid sgrub pa yin no/ /lhag chad bskang zhing bzod par gsol/ oṃ dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ bi shwa rū pa dha ri gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā baṃ s+thā naṃ kṛ tan+te na sarba bud+dha shang bi sardza ye ta ma ma kar+ya ku ru swāhā/ zhes = sngags kyi rtsa thig gi thad dang*/ thig chen brgyad kyi thig rnams thog mar dbyi rdul tshon lhag ma rnams bum par blug / klu brgyad cho ga spyi dang mthun pas chu bor spyan drangs/ slar yang bum pa chus bkang ste dkyil 'khor gyi sar gtor de shis brjod rgyas par bya'o/ /phyag len pa ni/ rjes chog mchod stod kyi rjes su yang shis brjod re mdzad do/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba'i nyin zhag thams cad dam skabs 'dir nges par sbyin bsregs bya ste/ /de cho ga ni 'o snye las shes par bya'o/ /de yang ma 'grub na gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa nyin so sor nges par bya'o/ /dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun rnam par spel ba 'di/ /gangs can zhing sar kho bos nyer drangs pa/ / skal ldan zhing sa rnams kyi nyer 'tsho ste/ /thub bstan skyed tshal mchog tu rgyas byed yin/ /'di'i dge bas sems can thams cad myur du rdo rje 'chang chen po gyur cig/ // ces pa sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas 'di nyid kyi rgyud kyi 'grel pa jo bo rjes mdzad pa de nyid gzhir bzhag cing*/ phyag len gyis kha skong ji ltar mdzad pa ltar ma 'khrul bar bkod pa ste/ grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i man ngag /bla ma rnam gsum gyi zhal lung te/ rang lo nyer bdun pa la bkod pa'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig /sarba mad+ga laṃ/ / bkra shis/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rje btsun sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/
